people.name: Cain
people.line: Adam and Eve's firstborn son, killed his brother Abel

translations.web: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.
translations.bsb: but He had no regard for Cain and his offering. So Cain became very angry, and his countenance fell.
translations.kjv: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
translations.asv: but unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
